name: geox_basin
desc: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.

name: geox_calibration_register_witness
desc: Register a CalibrationWitness for structural interpretation. Validates schema, checks completeness blockers (missing axes, depth-without-velocity). Returns VOID on bad input, HOLD on missing calibration.

name: geox_claim
desc: Claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, falsify, synthesize, contradict. Modes: create, validate, challenge, seal, attach, falsify, discover, synthesize, abduct, contradict, scan.

name: geox_contrast_metabolize
desc: Unified anomalous contrast metabolic pipeline. Binds three stages into one call: ISOLATE (deterministic acoustic impedance contrast detection) then MEASURE (AVO gradient + LMR estimates) then CLASSIFY (>=3 stratigraphic trap hypotheses). substrate_class=INERT. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE - arifOS seals.

name: geox_deep_time
desc: Deep time: Earth state, dynamical systems, DDE reasoning. Modes: dde_reason.

name: geox_extract_display_proxy
desc: Extract display-derived proxy from raster seismic image. Requires CalibrationWitness. Output labeled DISPLAY_DERIVED_PROXY — NOT suitable for AVO, amplitude preservation, or native well-tie.

name: geox_extract_native_trace
desc: Extract a native seismic trace from a registered source. Returns NativeTraceRef with full provenance. HOLD for unverified authority, restricted data, or missing source.

name: geox_geomechanics
desc: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.

name: geox_glof
desc: Unified GLOF multi-phase cascade simulation. Multi-phase physics: solid dam → granular debris → liquid flood (Mohr-Coulomb + Saint-Venant + 33D zen-33 state). Modes: run (full cascade in one call), inverse (Bayesian grid-search), mcmc (MCMC posterior), propagate (Saint-Venant 1D), phase (yield surface debug). Replaces 7 individual geox_glof_cascade_* tools (333 ARCHITECT 2026-09-19).

name: geox_list_registered_sources
desc: List all registered native seismic sources with classification, authority, trace count, and sample metadata.

name: geox_map
desc: Map intelligence: layer discovery, scene composition, preview. Modes: layers_list, scene_plan, render_preview.

name: geox_model
desc: Geological modeling: subsurface inversion, 2D cross-sections, GemPy 3D. Modes: subsurface, geological_generate, gempy_3d.

name: geox_observe
desc: Canonical multimodal Earth observation umbrella (Earth Witness v1). Rock/outcrop/core/thin_section/fossil/seismic_display/map/section intake → governed EarthObservationPacket. Vision output is EVIDENCE only; interpretations stay HYPOTHESIS; no hydrocarbon claim from image alone (I1-I9); missing diagnostics → INPUT_REQUIRED; local ceiling QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.

name: geox_paleobiodb_query
desc: Query the Paleobiology Database (PBDB v1.2) for taxa, occurrences, and biozones. Modes: taxa (resolve a taxon), occurrence (fossil occurrence records), zone (biozones by scale), age_intervals (ICS / nanno / foram zones). Read-only, public-domain fossil data.

name: geox_petrophysics
desc: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.

name: geox_prospect
desc: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.

name: geox_register_native_source
desc: Register a native SEG-Y source for trace extraction. Validates file existence, computes SHA256, extracts binary header metadata. Authority downgrade: OPERATOR_APPROVED without actor → UNVERIFIED.

name: geox_seismic_compute
desc: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.

name: geox_seismic_ingest
desc: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.

name: geox_seismic_interpret
desc: One semantic capability — propose geometry, physics-gate, compare hypotheses (NOT autonomous SEAL). Live modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, structure_validate, interpret (interpretation_bundle ≥3 hyps), interpret_section/rsi_pipeline (INT_SEISMIC), segy_slice. Gates return PASS|WARN|KILL|UNMEASURED + receipt_hash. preferred_hypothesis always null from GEOX. Local max QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE — arifOS seals only.

name: geox_source
desc: Source rock & diagenesis: TOC, kerogen, maturity, compaction. Modes: source_rock, diagenesis.

name: geox_spatial
desc: Spatial intelligence: H3, LanceDB, STAC. Modes: h3_index, lancedb_store, stac_discover.

name: geox_surface_status
desc: Canonical registry probe: public surface truth (count, canonical_tools, verdict). Self-witness for surface SOT.

name: geox_temporal
desc: Temporal analytics: decline curve, RRR, basin lifecycle, cadence. Modes: decline, rrr, basin_lifecycle, cadence.

name: geox_well
desc: Well intelligence: view curves, open desk, desurvey. Modes: view, desk.

name: geox_well_ingest
desc: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.

name: geox_well_qc
desc: Quality control for well data: depth monotonicity, null %, physical range checks.
